summary: A toggle for an on/off setting, with its label, description and error beside it, taking part in forms.

label.note: Visible label next to the switch and accessible name. Required: shadow DOM keeps external <label for> from naming the inner input.

hideLabel.note: Visually hides the label; it stays the accessible name. Use only when the row has other visible text naming the switch.

error.note: Error message. Setting it marks the field invalid (customError).

size.note: Track and thumb size: default 32x20 with a 16px thumb, sm 24x16 with a 12px thumb. Label typography does not change.

value.note: Submitted with the form while on.

checked.note: On or off. Not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset.

required.note: Native required: must be on to submit. Adds an aria-hidden asterisk after the label.

disabled.note: Native disabled; dimmed; not submitted. A disabled fieldset ancestor has the same effect without changing the attribute.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.notes: Grid: switch in the first column, label, description and error in the second.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.notes: The track: pill-shaped, sized by size; positions the thumb over the native input.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.notes: Native <input type="checkbox" role="switch">, transparent over the track; receives focus, Space and validation.

anatomy.name: thumb
anatomy.notes: Round knob, decorative; at the inline start when off, the inline end when on (mirrored in RTL). Slides with switch.transition-*; no transition under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (WCAG 2.3.3).

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.notes: Native <label for> in the same shadow root.

anatomy.name: error
anatomy.notes: Persistent polite live region; text appears when invalid.

input.note: Each toggle by the person. Native and composed, so it crosses the shadow boundary.

change.note: Toggle committed. Re-dispatched from the host because native change is not composed (NativeControl). Not fired when checked is set from code.

focus-visible.note: 3px solid ring around the track in ring color (a translucent ring would fall under 3:1).

checked.note: Track fills with primary; the thumb moves to the inline end.

invalid.trigger: error set, or required and off after blur or a submit attempt

disabled.trigger: disabled attribute or a disabled fieldset ancestor

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: The label prop, through a native <label for> in the same shadow root.

formAssociation.note: FormAssociated + NativeControl mixins. ElementInternals: setFormValue(value) only while on, null while off; validity mirrored from the inner input (required -> valueMissing); formResetCallback restores the checked attribute's default; formStateRestoreCallback restores checked; a disabled fieldset disables it through isDisabled without touching the disabled attribute; disabled is not submitted; <label for> on the host is forwarded to the inner input.

accessibility.targetSize: Track is 32x20 (default) or 24x16 (sm); the label next to it is part of the clickable row and the 12px gap satisfies the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception.
accessibility.focusRingVisible: On keyboard focus of the input; 3px ring in switch.focus-ring.color around the track.
accessibility.missingNameWarning: Dev-only console warning, once, when label is empty.

keyboard.Tab: move focus to and from the switch
keyboard.Enter: submits the form (implicit submission; the control has no form owner in its shadow root, SB-0009). Does not toggle.

aria: role="switch" on the native checkbox; on/off exposed from the native checked state (aria-checked is not set by hand)
aria-describedby -> description and error ids (same root)
required: native required; the asterisk is aria-hidden
error: sets a customError validity, so the form blocks submission
no mixed state: a switch is only on or off
announcements: error text is announced once when it appears (persistent aria-live=polite region)

useCases.when: A setting that is either on or off, such as enabling notifications
useCases.use: sb-switch with a label naming the setting

useCases.when: The consequence of turning it on needs explaining
A dense settings list or a table row
The setting must be on before the form submits
useCases.use: required with a label that states what is being enabled

antiPatterns.pattern: A switch for a choice that only takes effect after a separate confirm, alongside other checkboxes
antiPatterns.why: A switch reads as a setting that is on or off now; a recorded choice reads as a checkbox (APG switch pattern vs checkbox)

antiPatterns.pattern: A label that changes with the state ("On" / "Off")
antiPatterns.why: The state is already announced; the APG switch pattern says the label must not change when the state changes
antiPatterns.alternative: A fixed label naming the setting

antiPatterns.pattern: Choosing one of several options with a row of switches

drift.contract: label, description and error are props of Switch
drift.realization: shadcn composes Label and Field parts around Switch; shadow DOM requires them inside
shadcn's bg-input is neutral-200, below 3:1 against the page; changed for WCAG 1.4.11

drift.contract: thumb is color.background off, color.primary-foreground on, in both modes
drift.realization: shadcn's dark thumb is foreground when off; one alias per role keeps the token layer one step and passes 3:1 against the track
shadcn default track is 32x18.4 and sm 24x14; rounded to the 4px grid already in the semantic tokens
not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset

openQuestions.question: Contract content drafted with the contract-author skill (visual reference, WAI-ARIA APG)?
openQuestions.answer: Yes: the visual reference for look, sizes and API; APG switch pattern for role and keyboard; Checkbox's form-associated field layout for label, description and error.

openQuestions.question: Native <input type=checkbox role=switch>, or a <button role=switch> with aria-checked?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: native checkbox with role=switch (SB-0007, native first). It gives Space, required/valueMissing and validation messages for free and reuses NativeControl. No reviewer was available; chosen in-session.

openQuestions.question: Does Enter toggle the switch (APG lists it as optional)?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: no. Enter submits the form like every other form control here (SB-0009); Space toggles. No reviewer was available; chosen in-session.

openQuestions.question: Is checked reflected to an attribute?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: no, as in Checkbox. The attribute is the default that form reset restores (like native defaultChecked).

openQuestions.question: Is label required?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: yes, as in Checkbox and Input; hide-label keeps it as the accessible name.

openQuestions.question: Which sizes, and what does sm change?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: the visual reference's two sizes, default and sm (aliases medium and small). Only the track and thumb change, from the existing size.switch.* and size.icon.* semantic tokens; label typography stays.

openQuestions.question: What does required mean for a switch?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: the native checkbox meaning, must be on (valueMissing while off), like a consent toggle.

openQuestions.question: Thumb color in dark mode: follow the visual reference (foreground when off) or one role per state?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: color.background off and color.primary-foreground on in both modes; listed as drift.
